fixture_manifest.adapter: External query-level fixture; group-level qrels unchanged.

success_definitions.positive_hit@5: At least one settled grade-1, grade-2, or grade-3 ayah in the first five results.
success_definitions.useful_hit@5: At least one settled grade-2 or grade-3 ayah in the first five results.
success_definitions.direct_hit@5: At least one settled grade-3 ayah in the first five results.

notes: Query wordings are evaluation cases; qrels remain question-group level.
Confidence intervals must resample question groups, not query wordings.
The test split is held out but not blind, and labels remain provisional.

slices.useful_answerable_hit@5: cases with at least one settled grade-2 or grade-3 ayah
slices.direct_answer_hit@5: groups whose best settled label is direct

selection.search: greedy pairwise coordinate transfers from each single field and a balanced start

limitations: Validation labels are provisional and model-assisted; this is not a blind benchmark.
Only English query wordings are available.
The test split was not loaded or scored by this tuning command.
